headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 19, 2026**
article:
The Cleveland Guardians secured a dominant 8-2 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Slade Cecconi earning the win. José Ramírez led the Guardians' offense, hitting 3 home runs, including an 8th homer on a fly ball to left field.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, affecting their team's availability. Jordan Beck, left fielder for the Colorado Rockies, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. Other injured players include Ben Casparius, Eric Lauer's teammate on the Los Angeles Dodgers, who has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation. The Texas Rangers have also placed Corey Seager on the 10-day injured list retroactive to May 15, 2026, due to lower back inflammation.

The Los Angeles Dodgers have made a significant roster move, acquiring left-handed pitcher Eric Lauer in a trade with the Toronto Blue Jays for cash. Additionally, the Chicago White Sox have acquired center fielder Junior Perez from the Athletics in exchange for left-handed pitcher Jackson Nove. The Athletics have also traded right-handed pitcher Kyle Robinson to the Pittsburgh Pirates for second baseman Alika Williams, and right-handed pitcher Eduarniel Núñez to the Baltimore Orioles for cash.

top_news.title: **Rays Rout Orioles 16-6**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Baltimore Orioles, securing a 16-6 victory. Junior Caminero led the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall Short in Philly**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds dropped a 4-5 decision to the Philadelphia Phillies in their latest matchup. Bryson Stott led the Phillies' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Rout Braves 12-0**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dominated the Atlanta Braves, securing a 12-0 victory behind a strong performance from Max Meyer. Javier Sanoja led the Marlins' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Place Jordan Beck on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies left fielder Jordan Beck has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. The injury occurred on May 18, 2026.

top_news.title: **Lauer Joins Dodgers Roster**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers have acquired left-handed pitcher Eric Lauer in a trade with the Toronto Blue Jays for cash. Lauer is now a member of the Dodgers.
